recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, full-body studio portrait of a male subject in a crouching 'b-boy' stance, framed by bold, heavy-weight typography at the top and bottom. The aesthetic is defined by high-contrast lighting on leather and denim textures against a clean, neutral background.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's head bisects the primary header text
Color coordination between clothing layers and typographic accents
Symmetrical crouching pose creating a triangular composition base
Heavy drop shadows on text mirroring the depth of the subject's clothing folds
coreInvariants: Neutral off-white or light grey background
Subject in a centered, low-angle crouching position

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally located, occupying approximately 75% of the vertical space, crouching low to the ground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and interlocked hands form the central focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large header text, move down to the subject's face, follow the arms to the interlocked hands, and finish at the footer text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space on the left and right sides of the subject's torso to emphasize the silhouette.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Neutral white/grey background and black leather jacket.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep burgundy/red trousers providing a warm base.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow/gold used for the turtleneck and typographic drop shadows.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value background contrasts with low-value, high-texture clothing.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Period marks are square and aligned with the baseline
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between condensed top text and extended bottom text.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the condensed, heavy display style of the header.
Provides the necessary weight and classic grotesque feel.
Matches the wide, technical look of the footer text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a man in a black leather jacket, red denim pants, and a black baseball cap, crouching in a centered b-boy stance against a plain white background. Lighting should be high contrast, emphasizing the textures of the leather and fabric.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold condensed black sans-serif text at the top, split by the subject's head, with a yellow hard drop shadow. Add extended yellow sans-serif text across the bottom, overlapping the feet, with a black hard drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Is the subject centered and crouching?
Does the top text appear behind the head?
Is the bottom text extended and yellow?
Are the drop shadows hard-edged and offset?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact wording of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Check that text is legible despite the overlap.
Ensure the yellow accent color is consistent across the layout.
Verify the crouching pose creates a stable triangular base.
Confirm the background is free of distracting elements.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio portrait + centered crouching pose + bold condensed header with offset shadow + bold extended footer with offset shadow.
